root.label: Kais Saied wins Tunisia presidential election

events.label: Kais Saied wins Tunisia presidential election

slots.name: vote share
slots.sentence: In 2024, amid political repression, Saied won a second five-year term with more than 90 percent of the vote. It was the lowest turnout of any election since 2011 at 28.8 percent.
